issues.title: EPIC: Enterprise Global Governance Control Plane (Single Policy Authority)
EPIC: Org-Wide GitHub Governance Enforcement (Rulesets + Branch Protections)
ac_entries: Organization-level ruleset(s) defined and versioned in repo
New repos auto-enrolled into baseline within 15 minutes
Drift report generated at least daily
Non-compliant repos are flagged and tracked automatically
Exception path requires approved waiver + expiration

issues.title: EPIC: Canonical Policy SSOT and Deduplication of Governance Sources
ac_entries: Single authoritative policy index with precedence rules
Duplicate/contradictory normative statements detected in CI
Legacy overlapping docs migrated or archived
Policy change requires changelog + approval workflow

issues.title: EPIC: Centralized Waiver Governance (Signed, Scoped, Time-Bound Exceptions)
EPIC: Kushnir.cloud Governance Admin Center (Backstage + Appsmith)
ac_entries: Backstage shows policy bundles, conformance by repo/team, and drift insights
Appsmith supports waiver approval/revocation and remediation actions
All actions mapped to RBAC roles and audit events
Policy rollout and rollback can be initiated from admin center
Compliance reports exportable for security/governance reviews

issues.title: EPIC: OPA Policy Service Evolution (From Repo Check to Enterprise Decision Plane)
ac_entries: Central policy bundles are versioned and signed
Repos/agents consume policy via discovery endpoint or defined distribution channel
Decision logs are persisted and queryable
Rollback to prior bundle works with audit event
Policy conformance tests pass across representative repos

issues.title: EPIC: Open-source control-plane adoption (Backstage/Appsmith) for portal DC model
ac_entries: Target architecture and ownership matrix approved
Backstage + Appsmith split implemented and documented
IdP, policy engine, and secrets system integrated with portal control-plane APIs
End-to-end flow validated for login, policy apply, extension request approval, revoke, and break-glass
Evidence package produced (tests, dashboards, runbook)
